verses.text: For the choir director. A Psalm of David. The heavens are telling of the glory of God; And their expanse is declaring the work of His hands.
verses.textZh: （大衛的詩，交與伶長。）諸天述說神的榮耀；穹蒼傳揚他的手段。

verses.text: Day to day pours forth speech, And night to night reveals knowledge.
verses.textZh: 這日到那日發出言語；這夜到那夜傳出知識。

verses.text: There is no speech, nor are there words; Their voice is not heard.
verses.textZh: 無言無語，也無聲音可聽。

verses.text: Their line has gone out through all the earth, And their utterances to the end of the world. In them He has placed a tent for the sun,
verses.textZh: 他的量帶通遍天下，他的言語傳到地極。神在其間為太陽安設帳幕；

verses.text: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber; It rejoices as a strong man to run his course.
verses.textZh: 太陽如同新郎出洞房，又如勇士歡然奔路。

verses.text: Its rising is from one end of the heavens, And its circuit to the other end of them; And there is nothing hidden from its heat.
verses.textZh: 他從天這邊出來，繞到天那邊，沒有一物被隱藏不得他的熱氣。

verses.text: The law of the LORD is perfect, restoring the soul; The testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.textZh: 耶和華的律法全備，能甦醒人心；耶和華的法度確定，能使愚人有智慧。

verses.text: The precepts of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart; The commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.textZh: 耶和華的訓詞正直，能快活人的心；耶和華的命令清潔，能明亮人的眼目。

verses.text: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever; The judgments of the LORD are true; they are righteous altogether.
verses.textZh: 耶和華的道理潔淨，存到永遠；耶和華的典章真實，全然公義─

verses.text: They are more desirable than gold, yes, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the drippings of the honeycomb.
verses.textZh: 都比金子可羨慕，且比極多的精金可羨慕；比蜜甘甜，且比蜂房下滴的蜜甘甜。

verses.text: Moreover, by them Your servant is warned; In keeping them there is great reward.
verses.textZh: 況且你的僕人因此受警戒，守著這些便有大賞。

verses.text: Who can discern [his] errors? Acquit me of hidden [faults].
verses.textZh: 誰能知道自己的錯失呢？願你赦免我隱而未現的過錯。

verses.text: Also keep back Your servant from presumptuous [sins]; Let them not rule over me; Then I will be blameless, And I shall be acquitted of great transgression.
verses.textZh: 求你攔阻僕人不犯任意妄為的罪，不容這罪轄制我，我便完全，免犯大罪。

verses.text: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in Your sight, O LORD, my rock and my Redeemer.
verses.textZh: 耶和華─我的磐石，我的救贖主啊，願我口中的言語、心裡的意念在你面前蒙悅納。
